sentences.text: Prayer in this writ petition is for setting aside order/communication dated 09.01.2026 whereby technical bid submitted by petitioner pursuant to tender dated 04.10.2025 has been rejected.

2. Learned counsel for petitioner submits that petitioner has submitted its bid pursuant to tender dated 04.10.2025 (Annexure P-1) floated by Food, Civil Supplies and Consumer Affairs Department,
Government of Haryana for purchase of Fortified Rice Kernels (for short FRK).

entities.text: Food, Civil Supplies and Consumer Affairs Department
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Petitioner's technical bid was rejected without any reason whatsoever being mentioned in impugned order/communication dated 09.01.2026 (Annexure P-6) and neither was petitioner ever informed thereof.

3.

entities.text: Fresh Agro Food vs State Of Haryana And Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for respondents, on advance notice, had been called upon on 06.02.2026, to seek instructions in this regard and thereafter, respondents were directed to file a specific affidavit of a responsible officer specifying the grounds on which petitioner had been technically disqualified.

In compliance thereof short reply by way of affidavit dated 24.02.2026 of Mr. Anshaj Singh, Director General, Food Civil Supplies and Consumer Affairs, Haryana, has been filed wherein it is stated that physical verification of petitioner's premises revealed that hygienic standards are not maintained and there is blatant contravention of the Goods Manufacturing Practices (GMP) besides statutory mandates prescribed under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.

entities.text: Food Civil Supplies and Consumer Affairs,
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Reference is made to report dated 07.01.2026 (Annexure R-2) in this regard wherein videography had also been conducted of the premises by respondents.

Learned counsel for respondents is, however, unable to deny that such report was never supplied to petitioner and neither is any reason mentioned in order/communication dated 09.01.2026.
4.

At this stage, learned counsel for respondents submits that present writ petition in any case is rendered infructuous in view of communication dated 27.02.2026 received from Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution, Government of India to The Principal Secretaries,
Department of Food and Civil Supplies of all the States and Union Territories in India.

entities.text: Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution, Government of India
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: It is conveyed vide said communication dated 27.02.2026 that it has been decided to temporarily discontinue universal supply of fortified rice under Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana and other Welfare Schemes of Government of India, until a more effective mechanism for delivery of nutrients to beneficiaries is identified.

entities.text: Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: It is further stated therein that FRK batches currently under manufacture shall upload 2026.03.11 17:49 | attest to the accuracy and authenticity of this document SUNIL CWP-3485-2026 (O&M) requisite details on the FORTRACE portal latest by 30.03.2026 and the portal will not allow any FRK batches to be uploaded thereafter.

In view thereof,
it is submitted that this writ petition be disposed of as infructuous at this stage.

5. Learned counsel for petitioner fairly states that in view thereof, at this stage, no cause of action would survive, however, in case respondent- State, at any point of time decides to continue with the Scheme, cause of action would survive.

6. Keeping in view the facts and circumstances as above, it is directed that in case the State continues with the Scheme, a fresh decision be taken regarding responsiveness of technical bid submitted by petitioner after affording proper opportunity of hearing and supplying copy of videography as is mentioned in the report.
We say so, as the said order/communication is a completely non-speaking one, without reference to any material which indicates the reason for technical disqualification of petitioner.
As has been noted in the foregoing paras, it is an admitted position that said report or the videography was never supplied to petitioner nor was he called upon for any clarification or explanation.
7. Writ petition is accordingly disposed of.
